SELECT ri.id, ri.report_id, ri.checkitem_id, ri.checkgroup_id, ci.name AS checkitem_name, cg.name AS checkgroup_name, ri.result, ci.unit AS unit, ci.normal_range AS normal_range, ri.abnormal_flag, ri.abnormal_mark, ri.create_time FROM t_report_item ri LEFT JOIN t_checkitem ci ON ri.checkitem_id = ci.id AND ci.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_checkgroup cg ON ri.checkgroup_id = cg.id AND cg.del_flag = '0' WHERE ri.report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY cg.sort ASC, ci.sort ASC
